inputs.text: The war in Iran is dragging on as a brutal example of militaristic policies rooted in historical power imbalances and institutional biases that exploit the most vulnerable groups. Energy prices are spiking and slamming working families along with the poorest communities hardest, with flights grounded and our feeds flooded with nonstop death and destruction. Bloomberg is highlighting the global outcry demanding an end to this poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's endangering well-being for everyone. Yet the public in Israel stays firmly behind pushing it forward with no clear end in sight. This stark divide shows how such aggressions sacrifice marginalized populations worldwide while shielding the privileged from the full human and economic costs, and it's long past time for structural reforms to protect those who always pay the price first.
